summary: CION Investment Corp filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing the full repayment of $114.8 million of its public Israel Series A Unsecured Notes (TASE-listed, US-equivalent: unsecured notes) at par plus accrued interest on August 31, 2026, and repayment of roughly $200 million of JPMorgan credit facility advances on September 25, 2026, releasing all related collateral. On September 17, 2026, CION closed a strategic joint venture, Senior Loan Fund Partners, LLC, with institutional investors. No board recommendation, advisor, per-share terms, or deal metrics were disclosed. What to watch: deleveraging pace, JV economics, and future NAV/financing signals.
